name: Maiduguri
headline: If the line goes down for 40 days, Maiduguri's critical sites keep 7% of critical service-hours today and 100% with the plan, without burning 59,245 litres of diesel.
headline_alongside: When it runs, the gas plant is cheaper per kWh than solar + storage: about N193 of federal operating support per kWh at 14.2 MW delivered, or N215 at its cost-reflective tariff, against about N684 for the solar systems. The plan does not replace it: it works alongside the gas plant and the distribution company, and keeps the critical loads running when the line or the plant fails.

ownership.owns: the facility's operator (state or private owner)
ownership.pays: the facility, from the diesel budget it no longer spends (pay-as-you-save); capex from a funder grant
ownership.guards: facility staff with the community around it
ownership.repairs: a local installer on a service contract, alerted by remote monitoring

ownership.owns: the ward borehole committee, with Borno RUWASA (Rural Water Supply and Sanitation Agency) as the state agency
ownership.pays: a small water fee per container or per household, set by the committee
ownership.repairs: trained local pump mechanics; installer warranty
ownership.precedent: 2024: government boreholes were 'being supplied fuel for six hours daily but ended up pumping water for only one hour daily', and the governor said 'We are going to set up committees for the boreholes in each ward' (Peoples Gazette, 'Governor Zulum promises solar-powered boreholes amid water crisis in Borno', 9 Apr 2024); RUWASA named by Arise News, 21 Apr 2025

ownership.owns: a cold-room operator or the market association
ownership.pays: traders, pay per crate per day: N100 (up to N250 quoted)
ownership.repairs: the operator, paid from the storage fees
ownership.precedent: ColdHubs pay-as-you-store model: 7 units in Northeast Nigeria markets (Dec 2020 to Jan 2021), N100 per crate per day, about USD 40,000 per unit and USD 150 a month to run (IFPRI, 2023)

cost_labels.solar: life-cycle cost over energy delivered in 15 years when the systems run their critical loads first from solar; undiscounted; health counts the clinic system only
cost_labels.diesel: fuel + O&M (USD 0.03/kWh, NESG/Boell 2017 from 2016 data) + the set's retail price (one Lagos retailer) over a 10-year life, for the same critical kWh the solar systems deliver; fuel only is shown as the lower bound
cost_labels.diesel_fuel_only: fuel only (price x L/kWh): the lower bound of the diesel bar
cost_labels.gas_support: operating support only; tariff and capital not included; point at the 14.2 MW daily average delivered (Dec 2024, NAN), up to the 50 MW nameplate; 32 MW was the generating figure. MEPP cost tariff 15.88 US cents/kWh against 6.2 US cents/kWh paid by NBET (Sep 2024; NAN via Peoples Gazette, 23 Feb 2025). Fuel: natural gas delivered by road tanker (plant manager quoted by HumAngle, 22 Mar 2024; Global Energy Monitor lists natural gas, diesel second)
cost_labels.breakeven: average delivered MW (and MWh a month) at which N2bn a month of support per kWh equals the solar cost per kWh; below it the support alone costs more per kWh

outage_ready_7d.label: the plan's sizing: PV with battery at 7.2 kWh per kWp, the smallest keeping 95% of critical hours at the 5th percentile in a 7-day outage

daily_cycle.label: daily-cycle design (our design rule): PV for one average day's critical energy at the site's mean hourly yield, battery for one night's critical energy (hours under 10% of the mean peak yield) at the stated usable share and round-trip efficiency; no multi-day autonomy. A cost arm only; the plan's sizing is the 7-day outage-ready design

labels.cost: life-cycle cost over energy delivered in 15 years when the systems run their critical loads first from solar; undiscounted; health counts the clinic system only; both arms priced the same way
labels.pricing: SEforALL prices PV and storage together ($/Wp at 7.2 kWh per kWp); a system with less battery per kWp is still priced by its PV, because no separate battery price is verified, so a smaller battery does not lower the price in this method
labels.csh: critical service-hours kept with each arm in the outage window (health includes the outage-ready fridge in both arms)

gas_tariff_cost_reflective.source: News Agency of Nigeria via Peoples Gazette, 'Firm proposes 50MW gas plant to boost power in Borno' (23 Feb 2025): 'MEPP is operating at unsuitable tariff of 6.2USc/kWh paid by NBET vs. Cost tariff of 15.88USc/kWh for an average of 41MW CCPP as at Sep. 2024'; brief13-sources Q5
gas_tariff_cost_reflective.label: the plant's cost-reflective tariff (Sep 2024) in naira at the CBN rate of 2026-10-27; NBET paid 6.2 US cents; a cost per kWh delivered by the plant, not by our systems

existing_onsite.name: University Of Maiduguri Teaching Hospital
existing_onsite.note: 12 MW UNIMAID/UMTH hybrid solar plant and a battery plant mapped in OSM (ways 1424431051, 1561720799); reported by the World Bank and press. The resident engineer described 7 MWh of batteries and a 10 MW diesel backup (Gatekeepers News, 25 May 2024); the Rural Electrification Agency lists it OPERATIONAL (EEP Phase II page); the UMTH share is reported as 4.5 to 5 MW

labels.scenario_today: today: no backup; the grid is forced off for the whole window (the line, or the gas plant, cannot reach the feeder); existing solar boreholes pump in daylight only
labels.scenario_today_diesel: today with diesel: a labelled scenario in which every site has a generator and fuel for the whole window; every needed hour is kept at the fuel bill shown
labels.scenario_with: with the plan: a solar + storage system at each site, sized to keep at least 95% of its critical hours at the pessimistic end (5th percentile) in a 7-day outage, run through this window
labels.supply: modelled from the NERC band promise (calibrated), as for the health facilities; promised, not measured
labels.diesel: generator fuel curves DERIVED from Cummins data sheets: clinic set 0.40 to 0.73 L/kWh (point 0.55) for health; 20 to 60 kVA set 0.31 to 0.40 (point 0.34) for water and cold; fuel replaced where a generator would run
labels.diesel_price: N3,277.47 per litre, national average: NBS Diesel Price Watch May 2026 via four outlets (VERIFIED_SECONDARY); low end NBS Oct 2024 N1,441.28; Borno April 2026 was N2,684.95
labels.water: pump kW from the iMMAP 2019 yield with an ASSUMPTION upper-aquifer head (30 to 70 m, point 40) and efficiency (0.40 to 0.60, point 0.45); deep lower-aquifer boreholes differ; survey from March 2019, statuses may have changed
labels.water_works: the water works load is an ASSUMPTION (30 to 300 kW); partner needed
labels.cold: one ColdHubs-type cold room per named market (5.5 kWp, about 3 t, VERIFIED_SECONDARY); its kWh/day is DERIVED from that array's yield at the market (NASA POWER, engine PV model)
labels.people_served: m3 per day / 0.015: Sphere 2018 minimum of 15 L per person per day (VERIFIED); a minimum, so this is an upper count of people
labels.umth: 12 MW UNIMAID/UMTH hybrid solar plant and a battery plant mapped in OSM (ways 1424431051, 1561720799); reported by the World Bank and press. The resident engineer described 7 MWh of batteries and a 10 MW diesel backup (Gatekeepers News, 25 May 2024); the Rural Electrification Agency lists it OPERATIONAL (EEP Phase II page); the UMTH share is reported as 4.5 to 5 MW; shown on the map, not fixed by this plan and left out of the totals
labels.sums: sums of per-site medians; lo and hi sum per-site low and high ends, wider than a joint interval
labels.ownership: PROPOSED model with the precedent named in each row; operators to be confirmed with partners
labels.security: each measure names its basis: the World Bank's anti-theft list, or our design standard
labels.gas_support: operating support only; tariff and capital not included
labels.gas_fuel: natural gas delivered by road tanker (plant manager quoted by HumAngle, 22 Mar 2024; Global Energy Monitor lists natural gas, diesel second)
labels.gas_tariff: MEPP cost tariff 15.88 US cents/kWh against 6.2 US cents/kWh paid by NBET (Sep 2024; NAN via Peoples Gazette, 23 Feb 2025)
labels.cost_solar: life-cycle cost over energy delivered in 15 years when the systems run their critical loads first from solar; undiscounted; health counts the clinic system only
labels.cost_diesel: fuel + O&M (USD 0.03/kWh, NESG/Boell 2017 from 2016 data) + the set's retail price (one Lagos retailer) over a 10-year life, for the same critical kWh the solar systems deliver; fuel only is shown as the lower bound
labels.roof: footprints from OSM building outlines: the buildings touching the site's own OSM outline, else the buildings containing the site point, else the single nearest building within 30 m; usable roof = footprint x an ASSUMPTION usable share (0.3 to 0.7) x an ASSUMPTION 0.12 to 0.20 kWp per m2; no building: ground inside the compound, or unknown where OSM maps no building within 250 m
